summary:

Domestic PTA has climbed 7 per cent since September 1 to cross $1,030 per ton; Indian Basket crude touched $128.70 per barrel on September 14.
Festive-season orders are keeping mills running, but output above 80 per cent is in question once seasonal demand cools.

title: Europe’s footwear machinery sector looks to automation through 2045
summary:
Europe’s footwear and leather machinery sector must combine automation, digitalisation, AI and service-based models to remain competitive through 2045, a VDMA TFL study found.

Raw cotton and cotton waste imports surged 67.67 per cent YoY in August.

title: US House advances Russia Sanctions Bill, India under 100% tariff risk
summary:
The US House has cleared a key procedural hurdle for the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 by 214-211, with two Democrats joining Republicans.
The vote allows consideration of Senate amendments to HR 5334 but does not constitute final passage. 
A separate House vote on the sanctions bill is expected Wednesday.

title: China opens Pinglu Canal to strengthen ASEAN freight links
summary:
China has opened the 134.2-kilometre Pinglu Canal from Nanning to the Beibu Gulf, giving southwest exporters a shorter waterway route to seaports. 
The 72.7 billion yuan project is designed for vessels of up to 5,000 tonnes and is projected to lower logistics costs by 18 to 30 per cent. 
The route is relevant for China-ASEAN sourcing, manufacturing and cargo planning.

title: The $547 bn fibre reset: Synthetics take 71.7% of demand
summary:

summary:
BKMEA has urged Bangladesh's government to create a high-level committee to coordinate garment-sector policymaking.

The agenda covers fair codes, energy planning, stakeholder-led policy changes, transport digitalisation and building-code implementation.

summary:

title: India's apparel retail revenue to grow 12-13% in FY27: Crisil Ratings
summary:

Festive demand, store productivity and responsive sourcing will shape full-year performance and supplier planning.

title: Bangladesh apparel exports price to US drops 2.26% YoY in Jan-Jul 2026

title: India’s US apparel exports fall 26%; Bangladesh overtakes China
summary:

Vietnam led at about $9.37 billion, while Bangladesh reached $4.66 billion and moved ahead of China.
Cambodia and Indonesia increased shipments as China fell by about one-third.

title: Argentina apparel imports rise 31.7% in Jan-Jul after liberalisation

China held a 52.03 per cent share, while Vietnam and Bangladesh grew 50.62 per cent and 54.52 per cent, respectively.
